For integers h ≥ 2 and M ≥ 2h + 4s + 10, put N∗ = M dim U and define Y = ( (ℓ1, . . . , ℓM ) ∈ U⊕M : M X m=1 w(ℓm) = 0 (w ∈ W) ) , X = P(Y ) ⊆ P(U⊕M ). Then X is a geometrically integral complete intersection of codimension s, cut out by s equations of degree b, and codimX Sing X ≥ M − 2s + 1 > h, with the codimension of the empty locus understood to be infinite. In particular, a general h- dimensional projective linear section is a smooth complete intersection contained in Xsm. After any embedding k ,→ C, let Y o be the nonzero cone over Xsm. Both Y o and its unit-norm retract are (M + 2h)-connected.
